A BLIND GIRL

Dear Madam,-
Would any Associate or [Member](/organisation/23), accustomed to cheer the blind, kindly get into communication with a Member, aged fourteen, a cottage child who is not in health for a blind school. She can knit, and read a little by Moon’s method, and has a mother and sister who can read letters to her. Her address is [Annie Nargate](/person/917) [sic], Fergern Hill, Otterbourne, Winchester; but it might perhaps be best to write to her Associate, [Miss Jacson](/person/1962), Yew-tree Cottage, Otterbourne, Winchester.		

I remain,
C. M. Yonge.
